name: 3 terminal tools
title: Claude Code's 3 terminal tools: zoxide, Atuin, lazygit
caption:
I asked Claude Code which terminal tools every developer should install. Its 3 picks 🖥️

① zoxide: a smarter cd that learns the folders you use most (z api → ~/code/clients/acme/api)
② Atuin: every command saved to a searchable database, with exit code, duration and time
③ lazygit: stage single lines, cherry-pick and rebase in a terminal UI

All three: brew install zoxide atuin lazygit

Comment "SHELL" and I'll DM you all three links 🔗
